page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre-left with page number at top right. Two illustrations on the left: a large engraved spiral shell (upper left, in the picture area) and a small engraved shell (lower left). Text block of running prose at lower right, right of the small shell, ending with a catchword "Reli-" at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: Tertia & quarta quæ se-quuntur elegantissimæ sunt, & constant ex materia are-nosa, duriuscula, quas è Se-danensi tractu accepi, ubi in vivo Saxo nascuntur: & sunt pene eiusdem mate-riæ cum quadratis Saxis, quorum in ædificiis usus est.

page.notes: Two engraved shell illustrations are on the page: a tall spiral shell with a curled apex and a small round shell with a spiral top, plus faint show-through of other figures in the upper area, which is not transcribed. The catchword "Reli-" is printed at the lower right. The text is set as a single paragraph.
